expansion_contract.fact_row: verified official-source, canonical-state, workflow-evidence or acceptance-contract fact
expansion_contract.boundary_row: prevents summary dimensions, denominators, confidential omissions, mobile operator algebra or structurally empty fields from being promoted to exact fixed-broadband postcode or parcel coverage without accepted r2 bytes and hardened postjoin evidence

source_routes.name: About this data fixed coverage and full-fibre take-up v2

facts.detail: The terminal heartbeat has no active owner lease.
No active or over-15-minute PENDING execution exists.

guard_streams.write_limit: No second task, owner takeover or parallel runner is permitted.

facts.detail: The exact 11,013-row output JSONL remains empty.
The source snapshot remains exact_rows_returned zero and source_scan_complete remains false.

guard_streams.write_limit: No candidate or 3/4 promotion before exact r2 and hardened postjoin acceptance.

facts.detail: The January 2026 collection contains submissions from 52 fixed-network and 18 fixed-wireless-access providers.
The Spring 2026 residential and commercial premise base uses AddressBase Premium and Islands Epoch 123.

guard_streams.write_limit: Provider counts and premise-base vintage do not prove an individual postcode metric.

facts.detail: The all-premises CW file had duplicated CV and the MK file had duplicated ME; v2 records both corrections.
All 121 all-premises postcode files were renamed from r1 to r2 after the correction.

guard_streams.write_limit: Only corrected r2 members may satisfy the strict archive contract.

facts.detail: The UK-and-nations fixed coverage file documents 495 rows and a 28 KB file size.
Its dimensions include location, premise type, rurality, speed category, percentage, premise count and snapshot date.

guard_streams.write_limit: National summary dimensions cannot replace postcode rows.

facts.detail: One take-up field uses all premises with full-fibre coverage as its denominator.
A separate take-up field uses all premises in the local authority as its denominator.

guard_streams.write_limit: The two take-up percentages are not interchangeable.

facts.detail: A local authority take-up percentage can fall when coverage expands faster than active full-fibre connections.
Ofcom notes that active full-fibre connections still increased in all local authorities showing that ratio pattern.

guard_streams.write_limit: A lower ratio does not imply fewer active connections.

facts.detail: Fixed coverage is published at local authority, Westminster constituency, devolved constituency, output-area and postcode levels.
Each level has separate all-premises and residential products.

guard_streams.write_limit: Fields must be joined only within their declared geography and premise population.

facts.detail: The postcode field stores the code with spaces removed.
The postcode_space field stores the code with a single space.

guard_streams.write_limit: Normalization variants must be compared deterministically and not treated as separate postcodes.

facts.detail: Output-area and postcode products omit full-fibre coverage because of commercial confidentiality.
Coverage fields refer to fixed-line broadband unless the field description explicitly mentions FWA.

guard_streams.write_limit: Gigabit coverage must not be relabelled as full fibre, and implicit FWA must not be added.

facts.detail: All Matched Premises requires a match to at least one fixed-provider record with a non-zero predicted download speed.
All Premises and All Matched Premises count fields are not present in postcode files.

guard_streams.write_limit: Postcode counts must not be reconstructed from percentages without exact denominators.

facts.detail: The matrix distinguishes superfast at 30 Mbit/s and ultrafast thresholds at 100 and 300 Mbit/s.
Gigabit-capable availability is a separate field from the 100 and 300 Mbit/s thresholds.

guard_streams.write_limit: Threshold fields must retain their distinct definitions.

facts.detail: Unable-to-receive 2, 5, 10 or 30 Mbit/s percentages use matched premises.
The fixed-or-FWA decent-broadband field includes unmatched records, zero predicted speeds, WISP and Mobile FWA.

guard_streams.write_limit: Unable-X and composite decent-broadband metrics have different populations and technologies.

facts.detail: Each subnational mobile file has 154 columns spanning service, coverage type and operator-count combinations.
Coverage from at least one MNO can be calculated as 100 percent minus coverage from zero operators.

guard_streams.write_limit: Mobile operator-count algebra cannot populate fixed-broadband fields.

guard_streams.source: Spring 2026 mobile data note and canonical workflow evidence

facts.detail: Multi-operator 3G columns are empty after three MNO switch-offs, and four-operator 5G SA columns are empty because one MNO has not deployed it.
The available current-HEAD workflow search returned zero PR-triggered runs, and no candidate, measured-speed or accuracy promotion was made.

guard_streams.write_limit: Structurally empty mobile columns and absent host evidence must remain fail-closed.
